Song Name	Are We Still Young (Hard) by Grant feat. Juneau [Monstercat]
Title	Are We Still Young (Hard)
Artist	Grant feat. Juneau [Monstercat]
Description	A track by American artist 'Grant' released in 2017 under the Monstercat label. From the artist: Personally, I find getting older means that it's harder to open up to the people around me. It's too easy to get caught up feeling like I'm in an endless daily routine where the days won't stop speeding up. These struggles are exactly what 'Are We Still Young' is about.
